title: Hiring for Lead Generation: What to Prepare and What to Avoid
h1: Hiring for lead generation: what to prepare and what to avoid
description: What to prepare before hiring for lead generation: ideal customer profile, data sources, list quality, privacy and anti-spam rules, outreach and measures.
intro: Lead generation freelancers can research prospects, build targeted lists and help you start conversations with potential customers. It is also an area where shortcuts cause real harm: bought lists, scraped data used without care and mass emails can damage your reputation, break laws and get your domain blocked. This article explains how to prepare a lead generation project, what good work looks like and which practices to avoid.

faq.q: What is an ideal customer profile?
faq.a: A description of the companies or people most likely to buy from you, based on industry, size, role and needs.

faq.q: Is it legal to email business contacts?
faq.a: It depends on the country and situation. Learn the privacy and anti-spam rules where your prospects are.

faq.q: Should I buy a ready-made list?
faq.a: Generally no. Bought lists are often outdated, lack consent and can harm your sender reputation.

faq.q: How do I check list quality?
faq.a: Review a sample: are contacts accurate, current and truly a fit for your offer?

faq.q: What should a good lead list include?
faq.a: Accurate names, roles, companies, relevant details and the source of each piece of information.
